description: 🚀 Team Nebula is ready to reach for the stars! Through creativity, teamwork and our game, THE STARDUST QUEST, we make learning about space fun, exciting and unforgettable. We believe that curiosity, teamwork and innovation can inspire the next generation of space explorers! 🌙✨🌝⭐️
summary: THE STARDUST QUEST is a fun, interactive, child-friendly game designed to make exploring  outer space enjoyable for children and adults, including those with short attention spans and ADHD. Players can choose from four characters: Mavis, Ella, Sylvie and Serena, each with a unique storyline. Along the journey, players discover information about technology left behind on the Moon and Mars. At the end of each storyline, players must complete a quiz to earn a certificate. Collecting all four certificates unlocks specially designed memes for each character. Through engaging stories, interactive quizzes and fun rewards, THE STARDUST QUEST makes studying outer space an exciting experience!
details: THE STARDUST QUEST is a fun game that allows players to choose a character out of 4, go through storylines, play quizzez and earn certificates in order to get special made memes. It benefits people who want to learn outer space but have a short attention span or ADHD a through interactive game. We intend to make this project fun for all ages while still allowing them to gain knowlege about outer space. Besides that, we also used AI tools such as CHATGPT, KIRO, LOVEABLE, VOICEBOX and GITHUB for coding and voice acting. Our project is creative mainly because we chose a storytelling challenge, normally other competitors would make book or comic but we made an educational, interactive yet fun game. We considered making a comic at first but we changed it into something more interactive since we wanted something more fun for kids and adults.
